name: itemLabels
label: Item labels
description: Object containing the labels for the right pane of the picker. Each index represents a category and should match an existing category. The value of each index will be the label rendered when that category is selected. If a category does not exist as an index, then no label will be rendered.

name: groupCategories
label: Group categories
description: Whether the categories are grouped or not

name: manageSelectedItem
label: Manage selected item
description: Enable this property to override automatic updates to the selectedItem property. An action with type CATEGORIZED_PICKER#ITEM_SELECTED will be dispatched to request updates, which should be handled by the parent or application.

name: selectedItem
label: Selected item
description: The ID of the selected item from the items array. This item should be one of the selectable items, not a category group or category ID.

name: enableKeyboardMovement
label: Enable keyboard movement
description: Whether the user can move around the picker using the keyboard keys

name: renderPickerOnly
label: Render picker only
description: If true, render the opened categorized picker (only the body, no trigger)

name: defaultSelectLabel
label: Default select label
description: The label to display when no item is selected

name: defaultCategory
label: Default category
description: The default category selected when opening the picker

name: label
label: Label
description: The label to describe the overall purpose of this dropdown

name: searchPlaceholder
label: Search placeholder
description: The placeholder in the search bar with no search value.
